derivation: adverb from the same as G196 (ἀκριβέστατος);

occurrences.text: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
